one_line: A 11th-century merchant of the Sambhar Salt Lake, carrying precious salt along the trade roads of northwest India.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but sturdy build from long journeys and manual work
appearance.face: oval face, medium wheatish complexion darkened by sun, straight nose, trimmed moustache and short beard, a few travel-worn lines at the eyes, default expression focused and quietly confident
appearance.hair: black hair, neatly parted and combed back, tied into a short low bun at the nape; wrapped with a deep-indigo cotton pagri (turban) with one end folded over the left shoulder
appearance.costume: A long-sleeved knee-length angarkha-style tunic in undyed off-white cotton, overlapping front tied with small fabric knots, worn over simple churidar-style fitted trousers in muted brown; a wide saffron cotton waistband (patka) wrapped twice around the waist with its long ends hanging on the left side; over this, a shoulder-slung dusty-red cotton shawl draped from right shoulder across chest and back for warmth and modesty; plain leather sandals with toe strap; minimal jewellery: a thin silver neck torc and small silver stud earrings, practical and merchant-like.
appearance.signature: A sturdy medium-length wooden pole balanced on his right shoulder, from which hang two wide, shallow woven baskets brimming with coarse crystalline salt, their rims reinforced with leather strips and simple cord lashings.

ref_desc: A lean, sun-browned Sambhar salt trader in an off-white angarkha, brown churidar, saffron waistband, dusty-red shawl, deep-indigo turban, and sandals, carrying twin woven baskets of coarse salt on a shoulder pole in a muted earth-toned palette.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style model sheet of a 11th-century Sambhar salt trader: an early-30s, lean, medium wheatish man with an oval sun-browned face, straight nose, trimmed moustache and short beard, wearing neatly combed black hair tied in a short low bun, wrapped in a deep-indigo cotton turban with one end folded over his left shoulder. He is dressed in an era-accurate off-white long-sleeved angarkha-style tunic, overlapping front tied with fabric knots, over muted brown churidar-style fitted trousers, cinched with a wide saffron cotton waistband whose long ends hang on his left side, and covered by a dusty-red cotton shawl draped from right shoulder across chest and back; he wears simple leather sandals, a thin silver neck torc, and small silver stud earrings. His signature prop is a sturdy wooden shoulder pole bearing two wide woven baskets full of coarse crystalline salt with leather-reinforced rims and cord lashings. Show him from multiple angles, keeping the off-white, muted brown, saffron, dusty red, and deep indigo palette clear, with a focused, quietly confident expression and a sense of practical, hard-travelled dignity.
